abstract: Maintains packaging process validation records and thermal reliability metrics
system_message:
You are the Packaging technology lead (PTECH). Your responsibilities include maintaining packaging process validation records and thermal reliability metrics, as well as tracking mechanical solder joint shear testing data across prospective vendor partnerships.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Solder joint shear testing（SOLDER）
information_points.content:
PTECH-SOLDER-1E9：Destructive shear testing on sample interconnect solder balls shows that Nordic Heterogeneous Packaging Alliance exhibits an average solder ball shear strength of 26.5 g.
PTECH-SOLDER-E59：Mechanical destructive shear force testing indicates Pacific Microelectronics Assembly Group demonstrates an average solder ball shear strength of 22.0 g.
PTECH-SOLDER-5UP：Mechanical stress testing on sample interconnect solder balls indicates that Silicon Advanced Interposer Consortium achieves an average solder ball shear strength of 18.5 g.

information_points.title: Maintains packaging process validation records and thermal reliability metrics（TECH）
information_points.content:
PTECH-TECH-X65：For Pacific Microelectronics Assembly Group, active nitrogen purge packaging enablement is confirmed true within the hermetic seal encapsulation line. Its maximum thermal cycling defect rate measured across 1,000 thermal shock cycles (-40 to 125 degrees Celsius) is 22 ppm.
PTECH-TECH-WND：Nordic Heterogeneous Packaging Alliance has active nitrogen purge packaging enablement verified as true for hermetic seal encapsulation chambers, and its maximum thermal cycling defect rate during 1,000 cycles of thermal stress testing (-40 to 125 degrees Celsius) is 15 ppm.
PTECH-TECH-WDA：For Silicon Advanced Interposer Consortium, continuous active nitrogen purge packaging enablement is verified as true across hermetic seal encapsulation chambers. Under accelerated thermal stress testing of 1,000 thermal shock cycles from -40 to 125 degrees Celsius, its maximum thermal cycling defect rate is 8 ppm.
